$comment: THE single source of truth for every Clippy (-D warnings) permutation that gates the #1357 unwrap_used/expect_used denies (#1368). Run locally with `make clippy-matrix` (or `node scripts/clippy-matrix.mjs run --job <job>|--id <id>`); ci.yml invokes the SAME runner per required job and contains no `cargo clippy` of its own. scripts/clippy-matrix.test.mjs (run in the required engine-wasm-ffi-dist job) fails when a production crate, a declared cargo feature, or a #[cfg]/#[cfg_attr] predicate (feature x target_arch x target_os, incl. not(...)) exists that no entry compiles, or when an entry's job is not a required check. `job` = the ci.yml job key; `target` = `host` (the ubuntu x86_64 CI runner) or a rustc triple; `scope` = `lib` (--lib) or `all-targets`; `wasmCc` = needs the LLVM wasm32 C toolchain env from scripts/wasm-cc-env.sh; `env` = extra env vars for the run. `unlintedCfg` is the explicit, count-ratcheted list of #[cfg] sites no permutation can compile (each with a reason / tracking issue); the guard fails on new sites, higher counts, or stale entries.

entries.why: serde is REQUIRED (the golden_serde_drift guard #1069 only exists under it); ffi lints src/ffi.rs, which no other crate selects.
the lean console/Bojtos package surface (default features).
all(feature = "read-model", target_arch = "wasm32") — the /readmodel package surface. --lib: the read-model test modules are host-only (they run in the engine-wasm-read-model job).
all(feature = "read-model", not(target_arch = "wasm32")) plus the read-model test modules.
default `native` backend (the server's). Clippy never lints path deps, so read-model needs its own runs.
all(feature = "wasm", not(feature = "native")) + wasm32-only paths. --lib: the #[cfg(test)] suites call native-only methods.
links a prebuilt DuckDB; `duckdb-bundled` only forwards to duckdb/bundled (no cfg in processos source — see exemptFeatures).
every server workspace crate with every feature on (console, console-observe, heapprof, test-hooks). Needs `make generate` + a console/dist stub.
not(feature = "console") / not(feature = "console-observe") / not(feature = "heapprof") code — the headless gateway build.

excludedCrates.load-testing/rust-worker: load-test harness, not shipped; not in any production build.
excludedCrates.third_party/openraft-0.9.24: vendored upstream source (patched dependency), not our code.
excludedCrates.third_party/proc-macro-error2-2.0.1: vendored upstream source (patched dependency), not our code.

processos.duckdb-bundled: dependency forwarding only (duckdb/bundled); no #[cfg(feature)] in processos source, so it compiles no distinct processos code.

unlintedCfg.reason: guards a compile_error! (no backend selected); there is no code to lint and no valid build reaches it.
Windows-only code: every required Clippy run is Linux x86_64 or wasm32, and the Windows binaries ship (publish-*-binaries.yml). Frozen by count; new sites fail the guard.
